summary: The SDK runtime notices about model selection (« ↪️ Model Fallback: … », « ↪️ Model Fallback cleared: … », « ↪️ Retried on … ») no longer reach a chat: an existing-SDK message_sending hook cancels a notice-only message and strips a notice line from a mixed one. Every other message is untouched; the fallback stays in the logs and lifecycle events.
reason: S24 29/10 17:57: after a WhatsApp reconnect (408) the owner run fell back and Amine received « ↪️ Model Fallback: openai/gpt-5.6-terra (selected openai/gpt-5.6-sol; unknown) ». Amine: « corrige ».

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-runtime-notices.cjs
tests.evidence: The exact S24 notice, the cleared and retried notices (with or without the emoji selector) are cancelled; a notice before a real answer leaves only the answer; ordinary texts, a sentence mentioning a fallback, empty and non-string contents are untouched.

architecture.reason: One existing SDK hook (message_sending) registered by the existing plugin; no new store, router or daemon.

limitations: Relies on the SDK notice wording of OpenClaw 2026.9.6; a reworded notice would show again (then caught by the test fixture update).
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core.
